description: Retrieval eval of the HealthCore knowledge base (BRIEFING Hito 7). A question is a hit when the expected chunk (source_document + chunk_index) is among the top 3 results of retrieve(question, k=3, min_score=0). Questions are paraphrased the way a patient coordinator would ask, not copied from the documents.
